name: Hetao29 Sign-In for WeCom
author: hetao

sections.description:
This plugin adds Enterprise WeChat (WeCom) sign-in to the login page. Visitors can log in by scanning a QR code or authorizing inside the WeCom app. Administrators can allow automatic account creation and optionally replace the standard username and password login form.

The plugin sends the authorization code to the WeCom API to retrieve the user’s enterprise ID. Administrators can bind an existing WordPress user to a WeCom User ID on that user’s profile. With automatic registration enabled, an unbound enterprise ID creates a new subscriber account. Existing WordPress usernames are never used to link accounts automatically.

External services

Sign-in requires WeCom. The login panel loads the WeCom JavaScript SDK from wwcdn.weixin.qq.com. During sign-in, the plugin sends the Corp ID and app secret to the WeCom token API and sends the resulting access token and authorization code to the WeCom user info API. See the WeCom developer documentation and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Settings > Enterprise WeChat Login and enter the WeCom Corp ID, Agent ID, and app secret.
  3. Authorize your site’s domain in WeCom. The plugin generates an OAuth callback URL under wp-admin/admin-post.php.
  4. Test sign-in before enabling the option to replace the standard login form.
  5. To allow an existing user to sign in, edit that user’s profile as an administrator and set their WeCom User ID. Automatic registration uses the configured Default Role of New User (subscriber by default).
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Bind sign-in requests to a browser with one-time OAuth state and require explicit account mapping.
  • Restore bundled Simplified Chinese translations and the configurable role for automatically registered users.
  • Rename the plugin and prefix stored settings and registered identifiers.

1.1.1

  • Use a plugin slug without the reserved wp prefix and improve the plugin description.

1.1.0

  • Improve login integration and settings.
